description: This Java interface defines the contract for a repository wrapper responsible for handling interest schedule models related to loans within the Fineract project. It provides methods for retrieving, writing, and validating progressive loan models and interest schedules based on loan identifiers, loan objects, and specific criteria.

classes.name: InterestScheduleModelRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: Java interface for a repository wrapper managing interest schedule models for loans.

methods.name: findOneByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the ProgressiveLoanModel associated with a given loan ID.

methods.name: findOneByLoan
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the ProgressiveLoanModel associated with a specific Loan object.

methods.name: extractModel
methods.description: Extracts a ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel from an Optional of ProgressiveLoanModel.

methods.name: writeInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Persists or updates the interest schedule model for the provided loan.

methods.name: readProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Reads a ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel based on loan ID, schedule details, and installment amount multiplier.

methods.name: hasValidModelForDate
methods.description: Checks if a valid interest schedule model exists for a given loan ID and date.

methods.name: getSavedModel
methods.description: Retrieves a saved ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel for a loan on a specified business date.
